tips.text: Refine the relics for Uncommon parts to Radiant (100 Void Traces each) in a radshare squad, but leave the Common-part relics Intact since Radiant lowers their odds.
Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy her relics from the Prime Resurgence tab of the Market to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen so they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
